biocontainers.name: aevol
biocontainers.summary: Digital genetics model to run evolution experiments in silico

biotools.summary: Aevol is a computational platform for studying the evolution of digital organisms under different conditions, allowing researchers to understand evolutionary forces and mechanisms shaping genome and transcriptome structures. It was used to test hypotheses relating to mutation rate and population size and their effect on genome reduction.
